4.why: the jack is a CVMidi port carrying encoded MIDI rather than a voltage, so it is given no family

comment: No source is published; the maker's page is at kilpatrickaudio.com/?p=virtue-vcv. Params 1 and 2 are the Up/Down Mode and Raw MIDI Mode flags; neither has a widget or a census position, so neither gets a line and both are covered by Menu lines. In Up/Down Mode a controller message with bit 0x40 set gives plus one and anything else minus one, held for five samples and written out at five volts per unit.
